patch_description: The current 0.99 score is close to the reference squared ratio (1/4.1658 ≈ 0.24004). Two targeted improvements: (1) add structured seed configurations — the D6h family (two staggered hexagonal rings plus two axial poles), which is the suspected optimal symmetry class for n=14 in 3D — to the multi-start annealed soft-min polish, so the optimizer starts in the best basin rather than only the icosahedron+2 basin. (2) After the axis-aligned greedy polish, add a targeted pair-separation hill-climb that moves the closest pair apart along the connecting direction plus tangential variants (letting the pair slide around third-neighbor obstacles, as pure axial moves get blocked), and simultaneously pulls the farthest pair inward, with step halving. This attacks the exact min/max pair bottleneck directly and can push the squared ratio to/past the reference 0.24004. Both changes are bounded in iterations to stay within the timeout.
